source_signature.notes: Batch 4G skill 4/5. Scope Operator-derived. The tightest-boundary skill in the chain: extracts the numeric GLOBAL maximum bending moment from a GIVEN finished diagram, consuming shear_moment_diagram_construction (skill 3) as input rather than re-constructing it. Owns exactly the sliver skill 3 ceded. Principle: interior M extrema at V=0 (dM/dx=V, cited from skill 2), but the GLOBAL max is the largest |M| among ALL candidates - all V=0 stations plus supports, free ends, and concentrated-couple discontinuities - including hogging (negative) moments. Worked example Operator-re-derived: overhang beam 12 m (pin A@0, roller B@8, free C@12), w=4 throughout, Ay=12/By=36 (reactions checked: ByX8 = 48X6). Diagram given and self-consistent: V(0+)=12, V=0 at x=3, V(8-)=-20, jump to V(8+)=+16, V=0 at free end x=12; M(3)=+18 sagging, M(8)=-32 hogging (M(8)=18 - (1/2)(5)(20) = -32), M closes to 0 at the free end. Candidates compared by magnitude: |M(3)|=18 vs |M(8)|=32 -> GLOBAL MAX = -32 kN·m hogging at x=8 (support B). The first V=0 station (x=3, +18) is deliberately NOT the answer - the overhang produces a larger hogging support moment, so the >=2-candidate comparison and the include-hogging rule genuinely bite (a single-hump SS beam would not exercise the skill). TWO-signal mapping: sign_or_placement_error at step 5 (selecting the wrong candidate - first V=0 over the larger hogging, or a max-|V| station - or mis-signing the winner), unclassified at step 6 (checking one candidate, reconstructing the diagram, straying into stress). solution_sequencing_error OMITTED: the diagram is given as input, so no authored step strands a prerequisite the way skill 3's reactions->V->M construction gate did - the signal is placed by error model, and here the input framing removes the strand. This completes the batch's sequencing-signal pattern: earned on frame_machine_equilibrium (member coupling) and shear_moment_diagram_construction (construction order), declined on the single-cut and given-diagram skills. axis_confusion omitted (no component resolution). simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). Serial-chain leaf: unlocks no further node.
